id.description: A unique identifier for the device.

ip.description: The current IP address of the device.

mac.description: The unique address for the network adapter.

model.description: A model type of the device.

activationState.description: Activation state of the device. This field is only populated for a device added by a unique activation code generated by Control Hub for use with Webex.

description.description: Comma-separated array of tags used to describe the device.

upgradeChannelEnabled.description: Enabled / disabled status of the upgrade channel.

sipUserName.description: SIP authentication user name for the owner of the device.

linePort.description: Identifies a device endpoint in standalone mode or a SIP URI public identity in IMS mode.

outboundProxy.description: Outgoing server which the phone should use for all SIP requests. Not set if the response has no body.
